scientific_integrity: The prime-23 sample and general resultant method are credited to prior work; the accepted claim is the uniform all-prime classification at levels at least three and sharp stabilization at five.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to exact order eleven over prime-power moduli; finite exact enumerator plus rigorous infinite-to-finite reduction; no independent validation or absolute priority guarantee.
title: Sharp fifth-level saturation for order-eleven power sums modulo prime powers
